question: इस क्लाइंट का कितना भुगतान बाकी है?
note: Asked on staging on 2026-08-06, in Hindi, by a real user. Bilingual questions are ordinary for this product and script detection routes them: the planner's phrase list carries the Devanagari terms, and the system prompt asks for a reply in the question's own script while proper nouns and figures stay exactly as the records spell them. A model swap that silently starts answering Hindi questions in English is the regression this catches, and the check is simply that Devanagari appears at all.
